prompt: Aggregate sales data into hexagonal bins showing total sales per hex
criteria: Must include config.baseBinLevel (H3 resolution, typically 3-7 for regional data)
Must include config.steps with a classification method like {'type': 'quantiles', 'count': 5}
Must include paint.color with a sequential palette shortcut (like @copper, @riverine, @galaxy, @neptune, @ylRed)
